notes: §1985:XIV.3.3.4 GR1: "No action is taken when an ENABLE statement is executed which specifies a source or destination which is already connected, except that the value in the status key data item indicates this condition", and the program-MCS path is unaffected. SetOne returns 15 (AlreadySet) without writing the endpoint, SetOutput writes error key 5 and 15/80, and Deliver moves held Outbound messages only on a real enable. The witness: SEND to disabled D1 10/2, ENABLE OUTPUT 00 and the count goes 0->1, second ENABLE 15/5 and the count stays 1. Probes at 85: (b) second ENABLE I-O TERMINAL 15, ENABLE INPUT TERMINAL on an enabled source 15, unknown queue 20, ENABLE OUTPUT on an input CD refused COBOL6170; the unaffected program path: RECEIVE from a DISABLEd queue still returns HELLO (00, length 5) and SEND to a DISABLEd destination is accepted (10/2) and delivered at ENABLE OUTPUT; (c) refused COBOL0902 at 2014/2023. The 15 SetOne answers where a queue-source path is still closed is the GR2/GR3 defect recorded on those rows, not this rule's.
